description: Liability is disputed; other driver refuses to share insurer; two witnesses.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Horizon Assurance claims, Leila speaking, how can I help?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Hello. I'm calling about an accident on Monday. The other driver says it was my fault, and it wasn't.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I understand. Let's take the details. Your policy number?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: FNX-902341. My name is Youssef Amrani.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Thank you Mr Amrani. When did the accident happen?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Monday the fourteenth, around ten to eight in the morning, on my way to work.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: And where?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: At the intersection of Avenue Mohammed VI and Rue de Fès, in Tangier.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Your vehicle's registration?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: 7731-D-6, the Hyundai Tucson.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: What happened exactly?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: My light was green. She came from Rue de Fès and hit the front of my car. Now she says I ran the red light.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: What damage does your car have?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: The front bumper and the bonnet are damaged and the radiator is leaking.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Anybody injured?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: No, no one was hurt.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: What are the other driver's details?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Her name is Nadia Cherkaoui, her plate is 90412-B-40. But she refused to tell me her insurance company.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: So you don't know her insurer.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: No. She refused to sign the constat too.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Did the police come?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: No, no police came. Maybe I should have called them.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Were there witnesses?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Yes, two. A man from the café on the corner, Omar Tazi, his number is 06 70 11 22 33. And a woman, Fatima Zahra Bennani, but I don't have her number.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: That helps a lot. What number can we reach you on?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Thank you, a claims handler will review the liability question with you.
